title: Closing in the coat
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (1999–2000 · deepening xix · the daily filled)
logline: Tuesday. Closing. The owner turns the card. Wood in the coat at the door. She says see you Thursday. He says Thursday. The coat's collar up in the door's draft. Four strokes.

panels.composition: The shop at four, dark outside, the OWNER turning the door's card to CLOSED. WOOD in the coat at the door with BARNABY.

image.prompt: a woman in reading glasses turning a shop door's sign at closing while a young man in a chore coat waits at the door with a small dog, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The card, turned. CLOSED. Her hand leaving it.

image.prompt: close on a hand leaving a shop door's turned sign, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The collar up in the draft. The coat doing what it's for.

image.prompt: close on a canvas coat's collar turned up against a draft in a doorway, black and white, no words

panels.composition: Wood and the dog out on the gravel in the dark. The shop's light behind. Four strokes: a coat, a dog, a door, a road.
